title: Reversing a left-shifted list update
statement: Let $B$ and $\Gamma$ be types, let $g:\Gamma\to B$ and $s:\Gamma\to B\to\Gamma$ be functions, let $b_0\in B$, and let $w$ be a finite list in $\Gamma$. Updating the reversed list $w$ elementwise with the corresponding values of $g$, using $b_0$ at the added final position, and then reversing the result gives the same list as updating $w$ elementwise with the values of $g$ on its tail, using $b_0$ at the final position.
